{07 0e 00}People always tell me my
clothes are way too plain.{01 00 00 05 00}

I want to be adventurous
and try out some different
styles, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 07 00}But it's so embarrassing.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
What if I look silly?
